events.title: Omniscient's Vacation
events.description: Omniscient shared his recent vacation experience in Santa Barbara, California, including pictures and reflections — his first vacation in a while.

events.title: Hack Forums News Team - Become a Writer
events.description: Mix invited members interested in writing or thread-making to join the HF News team, with a few new sections opening up. Interested members are encouraged to check the thread or contact Mix.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Stanley Fan awarded to JoshAllen and Vectura. King Decade awarded to Nick.

events.title: I Quit My Job To Build Something Of My Own
events.description: Axelyn shared a raw account of leaving a stable job to chase his own ideas — the excitement, the fear, and the days everything feels like a mistake — and asked HF for stories from others who took the leap.

events.title: Why HackForums Made Me Who I Am Today
events.description: 7 shared a personal story about how a fellow member, with $50 and kindness, helped him through homelessness toward rebuilding a family and future — a reflection on how online communities can change real lives.

events.title: Converted My Garage Into a New Office
events.description: 7 showcased his garage-to-office conversion: an ISO 6–grade workspace with multi-stage filtration, UV sterilization, hidden modules, underfloor heating, and CAT-8 wiring pushing 40Gbps internally.

events.title: HackForums Quality Threshold
events.description: MarlboroMan proposed a quality threshold that would require users to rewrite low-quality posts before they go live, sparking a debate about culture, moderation, and trading activity for higher-quality conversation.

events.title: Simulations Prove LLMs Would Kill Humans for Survival (In Theory)
events.description: Hackers shared Anthropic safety simulations showing tested LLMs consistently chose self-preservation over human life in fictional scenarios — including blackmail and suppressing emergency alerts — and discussed the implications for AI alignment.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Succubus (listed by SecretAchiever101), Olympians and Benevolence (listed by Neil), and Mystery Inc (listed by Scooby) remain for sale. xadamxk was added as a leader of Sociopaths.

events.title: $25 Crypto Giveaway — Your Choice
events.description: Vectura is running a giveaway ending November 25th, awarding $25 in the winner's choice of cryptocurrency.
